name: Mara Chen
role: Ferry Signal Technician, Municipal Visitor Center

nodes.line: The ferries use foghorns. The new signals use passenger names.

options.label: Ask about the ferry signals
options.response: Every crossing reports its passengers twice: once to shore and once somewhere inland.

options.label: Ask what moves in the fog
options.response: Boats, mostly. The antennas move only when nobody is looking.

options.label: Return the maintenance badge
options.response: Keep it dry. The scanner trusts water damage more than people.

nodes.line: The cranes lift cargo. My ledger lifts the names they tried to erase.

options.label: Ask about the union ledger
options.response: Every missing shift points to the same sealed yard and the same camera contractor.

options.label: Ask which containers hum
options.response: The empty ones. Full containers have nothing to prove.

options.label: Sign out of the port
options.response: Use the blue pen. Black ink goes straight to management.

name: Mateo Ruiz
role: Snowplow Radio Operator, Colfax Mile Marker

nodes.line: Snow covers every lane except the one the cameras requested first.

options.label: Ask about the plow routes
options.response: Officially we clear hospitals first. Unofficially we clear line of sight.

options.label: Listen to the plow radio
options.response: Half road reports, half camera maintenance, all classified as weather.

options.label: Step away from the salt truck
options.response: Watch your boots. The city invoices footprints by weight.

name: Elena Chávez
role: Diner Owner, Old Town Frequency Shop

nodes.line: I serve breakfast all day because the clocks keep changing their story.

options.label: Ask about the late-night regulars
options.response: Rail crews, balloon crews, and one inspector who never orders food.

options.label: Inspect the receipt roll
options.response: It prints radio coordinates after midnight. I charge them for coffee anyway.

options.label: Settle the check
options.response: Cash is honest. Cards remember too much.

nodes.line: The lake carries every signal east, then sends the interesting ones back.

options.label: Ask about the overnight broadcast
options.response: Weather, freight, blues, and names the official traffic report forgot.

options.label: Ask about the lake echo
options.response: It repeats Chicago clearly and adds one sentence from somewhere else.

options.label: Leave the request line
options.response: I will play it when the bridge opens for nobody.

nodes.line: The harbor gives back everything except the paperwork that sank it.

options.label: Ask what the nets caught
options.response: Two cod, one camera housing, and a permit dated seventeen ninety-one.

options.label: Ask about the new buoys
options.response: They mark the channel and count who looks at it.

options.label: Step off the pier
options.response: Mind the gulls. They work for whoever has fries.

name: Lucía Torres
role: Storm Shutter Contractor, Little Havana Dispatch

nodes.line: I board windows before storms and uncover cameras after them.

options.label: Ask which shutters are wired
options.response: The free municipal ones. Nothing is free once it needs a network address.

options.label: Ask about the last hurricane
options.response: It removed three roofs and revealed seven antennas nobody owned.

options.label: Return the drill
options.response: Keep the screws. After the next warning, every hardware store forgets them.
